title: Exploring the Nexus of Large Language Models and Legal Systems: A Short Survey
measurement_description: The paper surveys existing research on biases in LLMs, including persistent anti-Muslim bias (e.g., associating Muslims with violence) and biases induced by general religious keywords in the generation of legal case judgment summaries.
findings: The paper cites research showing that models like GPT-3 exhibit persistent anti-Muslim bias, frequently associating Muslims with violence and terrorism. It also notes that the presence of religious keywords can induce bias in the generation of legal case judgment summaries.
